description: Custom properties and link relations for AI governance extensions to OSCAL POA&M

properties.name: ai-rmf-subcategory
properties.values: NIST AI RMF subcategory identifier (e.g. GOVERN 6.1, MEASURE 2.7)
properties.purpose: No native OSCAL construct for AI RMF subcategory references

properties.name: ai-risk-persistence-type
properties.purpose: Native risk.status assumes discrete closure — no way to declare non-closable risk

properties.name: ai-gap-owner
properties.values: UUID reference to a party in metadata.parties
properties.purpose: poam-item has no native ownership field — ownership requires 5+ hop traversal

properties.name: ai-gap-status
properties.purpose: poam-item has no native status field — status lives on risk.status

properties.name: ai-lifecycle-phase
properties.purpose: Identifies which AI lifecycle phase the governance gap applies to

properties.name: ai-vendor-name
properties.values: Name of the third-party AI vendor
properties.purpose: Tags observations to a specific AI vendor

properties.name: ai-model-version
properties.purpose: AI risk is model-version-bound — not tracked natively in OSCAL

link_relations.purpose: Links to a vendor risk assessment report
Links to a concept drift or model monitoring report
